technical.lead: FMRB executive order State Farm record argument hardens Sunday
technical.body: The Frontier Model Review Board executive-order litigation vector sharpens on Sunday ahead of the May 15 14:00 EDT classified threshold briefing in S-407. Lawfare's Sunday-edition long-read by a former NIST CAISI policy lead frames the absent Administrative Procedure Act comment window as the dispositive litigation vector if the executive order ships on the Defense Production Act Section 708 voluntary information-sharing vehicle without supplementary notice-and-comment, with the State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument laid out in detail; Just Security publishes a parallel piece arguing the May 7 EU AI Office plus UK AISI reciprocity protocol and the May 8 Singapore IMDA plus Japan AISI memorandum-of-cooperation establish a customary-international-practice baseline a US-side cyber-evaluation regime should mirror to avoid an outlier posture. Senator Mark Warner's office confirms two additional May 15 witnesses: the NSA Cybersecurity Directorate director plus a Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center representative providing the operational view of Mythos-class capability exposure on Microsoft enterprise tenants. White House OSTP holds its line that the draft remains in interagency review.

technical.lead: Indo-Pacific cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter widens to eight jurisdictions
technical.body: The Indo-Pacific cyber-evaluation reciprocity perimeter takes a second weekend extension on Sunday. India's Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology plus the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team publish a joint Sunday note signaling intent to enter the Singapore IMDA plus Japan AISI memorandum-of-cooperation cohort as a formal observer with a 180-day domestic-consultation window pegged to the March AI Advisory and a Q4 2026 mirror-signature target; Taiwan's National Institute of Cyber Security confirms it will join as an observer under Track II shoulder-to-shoulder arrangements with the US AISI bilateral channel. The cohort that May 8 framed at four jurisdictions now reaches eight named candidates (Singapore, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand formally; Canada, Australia, India, Taiwan as observers) plus the UK and EU as the originating pair. Mistral, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google DeepMind reaffirm cohort participation; the operational threshold remains Mythos and GPT-5.5.

technical.lead: AutoGen and Semantic Kernel CVE pair extends Microsoft agent-stack wave
technical.body: Two new agentic-AI tooling-stack CVE disclosures land Sunday-evening Pacific time, extending the Microsoft open-source agent stack wave. AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9) is a checkpoint deserialization vulnerability in the agent-state-replay path allowing arbitrary code execution via a malicious checkpoint uploaded through a connected message broker; Microsoft patches in AutoGen v0.5.18 same-day. Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4) is an authenticated server-side request forgery in the plugin-manifest fetcher allowing pivot to internal cloud-metadata endpoints; Microsoft patches in Semantic Kernel v1.36.0 alongside an out-of-band advisory for the dotnet packaging. Trail of Bits publishes the joint write-up noting both CVEs follow the same agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern catalogued in the May 8 CrewAI and Haystack survey. In parallel, Sysdig Threat Research reports MCP-server median time-to-first-credential-extraction-attempt falls to 14 minutes on unprotected estates while Defender holds at 4.3 hours; Defender quarantine of net-new MCP servers reaches 28 percent.

technical.lead: Unsloth multi-GPU NCCL backend lands DeepMind router-aware RL stability
technical.body: Local-LLM fine-tuning crosses a new commodity-hardware threshold on Sunday. A Hacker News Sunday write-up documents a successful Mixtral 8x22B router-only LoRA run on a dual RTX 5090 workstation (64GB combined VRAM via NCCL) following the Saturday quantization-aware mode plus the Hugging Face PEFT compatibility shim, reporting 12 percent peak combined VRAM versus the full-LoRA-on-experts baseline and 74 percent accuracy recovery on the in-domain finance-news classification eval. Unsloth ships a Sunday changelog adding a multi-GPU NCCL backend for the router-only LoRA recipe targeting consumer dual-GPU workstation tiers, an ONNX export path for inference deployment without the PEFT runtime dependency, and a Triton kernel optimization that trims router-attention-step latency by 22 percent on Llama 4 Behemoth and Kimi K2.6 recipes. DeepMind's router-aware advantage decomposition v3 addendum (arxiv 2605.05844v3) shows the technique closes the long-context RL training-stability gap on the same dual RTX 5090 reference setup up to 96K-token contexts, demonstrating the router-only training mode plus router-aware RL plus multi-GPU NCCL backend compose cleanly on commodity hardware.
